title: Lusia
author_sort: Prayogo, Cahyo Wulan & Arijn, Iyung & Daulay, Fiky & Murti, Redi
comment: Lusia is a sequential illustration story collectively created by Cahyo Wulan Prayogo, Iyung Arijn, Fiky Daulay, and illustrated by Redi Murti. This zine follows the inner thoughts of Lusia, a young girl whose life is forever changed by the Lapindo mudflow disaster (often referred as Lumpur Lapindo or Sidoarjo mudflow) in Sidoarjo, East Java.  Told through a poetic, fragmented narrative that unfolds line by line across each page, the zine draws readers in Lusia’s fear, confusion, and grief. It serves as a visual testimony of an environmental and social tragedy that continues to haunt Indonesia's collective memory.
